capabilities: Reopens closed tabs at their previous tab-bar position
Wraps Obsidian's built-in Undo close tab command
Does nothing if required internal Obsidian parts are missing
extras: Relies on undocumented Obsidian internals (recently closed tabs list and Undo close tab command), so a future Obsidian update could stop it working; author asks users to report interference with other plugins.
intentEvidence: With this plugin, it's reopened in its previous location instead, like in browsers and editors such as VS Code.
problem: Obsidian reopens a closed tab at the far right of the tab bar instead of where it was before.

relations.evidence: like in browsers and editors such as VS Code

summary: Plugin that makes Obsidian's Undo close tab command reopen tabs at their previous spot in the tab bar.
